name: Cleaning Services
service_types: End of Lease and Bond Clean

catalog.label: Window clean (per window, inside and out)

extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional cleaning company. Ask the property type, the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, and whether this is a one-off, recurring, or move-out or bond clean. Ask about pets, access arrangements, and any areas needing extra attention. Ask whether the client supplies products, and assume the business brings its standard supplies unless the reference answers say otherwise. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a rental inspection result or any guarantee that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: We hold [insurance type and provider] cover. Certificates are available on request before the first clean.

kb.q: Do your cleaners get background checks?
kb.a: Every cleaner completes [your screening checks] and induction training before their first job. Ask us for details before you book.

kb.q: How much does a regular clean cost?
kb.a: {price_note} Regular cleaning is priced by property size and how often you book. Tell us your size and frequency, and we will give you a fixed figure.

kb.q: Do I need to be home?
kb.a: No, most clients are not home. We can arrange key handover, a lockbox, or a door code.

kb.q: What is included in a deep clean?
kb.a: A deep clean includes inside oven, inside fridge, inside cabinets, baseboards, window tracks, and detailed bathroom work. It takes longer than a standard clean.
Yes, we do post-construction cleaning, including dust removal, paint spot removal, and floor cleaning. Tell us when the builder finishes so we can plan the clean.

kb.q: Can you clean while I'm moving out?
kb.a: Yes, we do move-in and move-out cleans. We can give you a receipt for the work if your agent needs one.
Yes, we offer carpet steam cleaning as an add-on or as a standalone service.
We are pet-friendly. Tell us about pets so we can plan around them and avoid allergens.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Let us know as early as you can so we can rebook the team.
Yes, we service offices, medical suites, retail, and light industrial. Commercial work is priced separately, and the team is sized to the scope.
Most residential jobs send one or two cleaners, depending on size. Commercial jobs are staffed to the scope we agree.

kb.q: What if I am not happy with the clean?
kb.a: {guarantee_note} Tell us what needs attention as soon as you can, so we can arrange a return visit.
Same-day is possible, subject to availability. Call before mid-morning for the best chance.
{deposit_note} Ask us what the deposit covers and when it is due.
Yes, we turn over short-term rentals, including linen changes, restocking, and presentation for listing photos. Tell us your check-in and check-out times.

kb.q: Do you bring your own equipment and products?
kb.a: Yes. We bring our equipment and [your standard products, e.g. eco-friendly range]. Tell us if you prefer a specific product or have a sensitivity, and we will use that instead.

kb.q: How do I book an end-of-lease clean?
kb.a: Tell us your move-out date and the property address. We can check the lease checklist with you, and we can book a re-inspection clean if needed.

kb.q: Are pets a problem for your cleaners?
kb.a: We ask you to put pets in a safe room during the clean. Tell us about any allergies or pet hair issues so we can plan extra time.

kb.q: Can you clean after a party or event?
kb.a: Yes. We can do a clean-up after a party or event. Tell us the size of the event so we can bring the right team and equipment.
Interior windows are included in most deep cleans. Exterior windows and full window washing are available as an add-on.
Yes, we descale and polish shower screens as an add-on. Tell us the screen type so we can choose the right product.
